newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs rally seen shortlived if Bunds, T-bonds dive.
newsitem.headline: OLOs rally seen shortlived if Bunds, T-bonds dive.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds (OLOs) outperformed Bunds late on Tuesday but dealers said the rally was due to technical factors and would likely prove shortlived.
U.S. Treasuries dipped pulling Bunds with them late on Tuesday after Federal Reserve Governor Janet Yellen said the U.S. economy had entered an inflationary danger zone.

However, Belgian OLOs, which traditionally lag Bunds in down moves, remained well bid, partly due to short covering after a Belgian Treasury exchange auction. "I think the auction was smaller than expected," one trader said, referring to 14.5 billion francs in OLOs exchanged.
